title: Weekly Recap
message:
We just logged a clean statement week: **Season 130, Week 1 = 1st place, 10,000 fame, +20 war trophies**. The best part wasn’t just the finish — it was the contrast. When the rest of the podium is sitting at **0 fame**, the clan that *shows up* doesn’t “edge out” a win… we take the river for free and convert it straight into trophies. War trend is **up**, and it’s not subtle.

The engine was a tight group that treated battle days like clockwork. **raquaza** led the charge with **3,050 fame (16 decks)**, **66** dropped **3,000 fame (14 decks)**, and **Vijay** delivered **2,850 fame (16 decks)**. Behind them, **King Thing (2,700)** and **Chanco (2,300)** kept the pace brutal and the gap uncloseable. That’s the POAP KINGS identity in one race: reliable decks, heavy fame, no excuses needed.

Ladder and progression had real life in it too. **JaxikoLane** had the loudest growth spurt: **+10 King Levels**, **+1 PoL league**, and pushed up to **9,066** (big gains on both best and current). **Chanco** kept thriving in the high-trophy air with **+306 best** and **+283 current**, and **Ditaka** stacked a strong week with **+1 PoL league** and a climb to **8,589**. Biggest raw trophy surge goes to **shimmeringhost** with **+701 (2,085 → 2,786)** — that’s a “welcome to the clan” week. Also: **Vijay** climbed **+3 PoL leagues** while landing at **12,000 trophies** even after a small **-62** dip; that’s still elite consistency.

The clan economy stayed healthy: **1,054 donations** on the week, with the current pace-setters **JaxikoLane (152)**, **Chanco (134)**, **Vijay (120)**, **King Thing (115)**, and **King Levy (112)**. And we’re still in founding-era recruiting momentum — welcome again to **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん**, **shimmeringhost**, **stewart**, and **Ditaka**. Next week is simple: if you can play, **get those 4 war decks in on battle days** and keep this “first place as a habit” energy rolling.
